title: Serving UC trace location must read MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID directly, not via _get_experiment_id
answers: Why do traces for a Unity Catalog experiment go to the inference table in Databricks Model Serving?
UC trace location not resolved in model serving, spans missing from the otel_spans table
_resolve_experiment_uc_location fails in serving because the experiment is not in the local store
Serving traces fall back to inference tables instead of UC experiment tables
body:
Symptom: In Databricks Model Serving, traces for an experiment bound to Unity Catalog are written to the inference-table path instead of the UC-backed experiment table.
Root cause: mlflow/tracing/provider.py:_resolve_experiment_uc_location called _get_experiment_id(), which validates the experiment against the local tracking store. In serving that store does not contain the experiment, so the lookup fails; the surrounding try/except returns None, so resolution silently falls through to the inference-table path with no error surfaced.
Fix pattern: Branch on the serving flag and take the id from MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID.get() in serving; keep _get_experiment_id() for every other environment. The serving branch is the only place that skips local validation.
Constraints: Applies only when in_serving is true. Do not remove the local-store path for non-serving callers, and do not add local-store validation to the serving branch, or UC routing silently regresses.
applies: mlflow/tracing/provider.py experiment-id resolution for UC trace location; serving branch only.

search: In Databricks Model Serving, mlflow/tracing/provider.py:_resolve_experiment_uc_location must read the experiment ID directly from MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID.get() rather than calling _get_experiment_id(). Calling _get_experiment_id() performs local tracking store validation that fails in model serving, silently falling back to the inference-table path instead of the Unity Catalog experiment table. Skipping local-store validation is restricted to when in_serving is true, while all non-serving callers must retain the local-store path. Applies to mlflow/tracing/provider.py experiment ID resolution for Unity Catalog trace locations in the serving branch only.
